description: This Dart file defines the 'HomeScreen' widget for a Flutter application. It constructs the main landing page of a cricket team app, featuring hero banner, stats, recent results, upcoming matches, navigation tiles, leaderboards, a CTA band, and footer. It references multiple local widgets and services to build and display the UI.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the app's home screen with various sections including hero banner, stats, results, navigation, leaderboards, CTA, and footer.

classes.name: _HeroBanner
classes.description: A private widget displaying the hero image with overlay text and call-to-action button.

classes.name: _LeaderCard
classes.description: A widget displaying individual leaderboard entry with rank, title, name, and stat.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for HomeScreen, assembling all sections and UI components.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the hero banner with background and overlay content.
